result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from every promotion query you listed. The full suite passes (608 tests), and nothing is committed.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` is the last record component. It is null when none was given.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new overload `createPromotion(code, discount, start, end, category, description)`. The existing 5-argument method delegates with `null`, so the ~40 existing callers are untouched. A null or blank description is stored as null, the same way blank categories are handled.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description. The six promotion SELECTs (by code, active on date, active in region, by category, best for category on date, unused in period) read it.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new test covering a described and an undescribed promotion across active, category, unused, best-promotion and code lookup.

I did not cover the region query (`listActive(date, region)`) in the new test. It uses the same reader code as the other queries, but it has no direct assertion.
